Every year at the end of October, millions of monarchs finish a 2,500 mile flight and settle into the oyamel forests of Michoacán. They land the same week the ofrendas go up. The Purépecha believe the souls have taken the form of the mariposa, and they’ve come home for Día de Muertos.

Nobody makes the trip alone, that's what the alebrijes are for. Meet Catrina’s DRAGONS and JOKERS.

That’s everybody, no one forgotten. Comment ‘Catrina’ and we’ll send you the link.

Come dusk, the graves get swept, the veladoras get lit, and everybody turns up carrying their loved one’s favorite food. Tamales, pan de muerto, a mariachi if there’s one to be had. Look close, pan de muerto was left on one of the graves.

They go in from all four directions. East, as always, goes first. Meet Catrina’s WINDS.

No one sits this one out. Comment ‘Catrina’ and we’ll send you the link.

The night before they arrive, a path of cempasúchil petals gets laid from the door of the house all the way to the ofrenda, so the dead can find their way in.

A flower for a joker is a trade nobody argues about. These are coming from a hand that loved you. Time to pick up Catrina’s FLOWERS.

Follow the petals. Comment ‘Catrina’ and we’ll send you the link.

BESPOKE IS GROWING! 💕 A FAREWELL TO OUR DALLAS PLAYHOUSE 🩷

As Bespoke Mahjong continues to grow, we need more warehouse space! It’s a great problem to have, but it means we’ve made the bittersweet decision to close our House of Mahjong—our Dallas-area playhouse where we’ve hosted classes, parties, and open play—and use that space for our growing business.

Bespoke Mahjong is still very much open and getting bigger and better! Our tiles, tables, accessories and exciting new collections are all continuing. This farewell is just to our local play space. 💕

To everyone who joined us at the House, took a class or made a new friend around our tables, thank you! You filled this special space with laughter, friendship and LOTS of mahjong.

A very special thank-you to Nancy, who has been the heart of HOM from day one! Thank you for making everyone feel so welcome and pouring so much love into our mahjong community. Nancy is staying with the Bespoke team, and we’re so happy she’ll continue this journey with us! 🩷

Our house_mahjong account will soon have a new name, and Nancy will be sharing lots of mahjong inspiration there. Already following? You’re all set! And keep following bespoke_mahjong for new collections, launches and all things Bespoke.

A website called ALOXO is using our Wooden Mahjong Rack photos and custom color charts to sell racks that are NOT ours. We have no connection to them, and we do not wholesale to any other website.

Their prices may look similar, but you won’t receive our quality craftsmanship or our custom colors. Every Bird & Bamboo rack is made with care right here in North Carolina. 🀄

✅ The only places to buy from us: birdandbamboo.com and our Etsy shop (links in bio)

If you’ve ordered from ALOXO thinking it was us, please DM us and contact your card company. And if you spot our photos anywhere else, we’d be so grateful if you’d send us a screenshot.

Thank you for looking out for this small business, and please share so others don’t get fooled. 💛
